DuplicateRule.alertText: A household or organization with this name and address may already exist. Look at the records below before you save a second one.
DuplicateRule.description: Warns when a household or an organization being saved looks like one the org already has, and records the pair so it can be reviewed later in Nonprofit Settings, Duplicates. It warns and never blocks (canonical model R-DP1). Ships inactive, because a matching rule is deployed inactive and a duplicate rule cannot be active until the matching rule it names is.
